verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email is an email marketing platform, so a separate transactional-sending stream is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only covers marketing campaigns, lists, the template builder and the API. Nothing documents a transactional channel with its own templates, suppression rules or sending reputation that would deliver a receipt to an unsubscribed contact.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
